violations.reason: The client brief explicitly requires fixing HTTP 401 errors on endpoints that must answer 200/201 (e.g., employee dossier search, document listing) and implementing Moodle course-based access control (Автоматическое разграничение прав доступа к закрытым штаммам и аналитическим отчетам на основе кафедр и курсов Moodle). While PR #1793 added a task plan for these items, the subsequent implementation PR #1794 completely omitted them, and they remain unaddressed in the provided merged PRs.

PR #1795 issued an 'approve' verdict while noting that requirements 1, 2, and 4 were not addressed, violating TAG-00's requirement that an APPROVE decision is strictly binary and only given when the PR satisfies all criteria (соответствует всем критериям).
